prose: The New York Times reports that Google is partnering with talent agency Range Media to launch 100 Zeros, a rotating fund meant to shape positive onscreen portrayals of tech and to test AI tools. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; the article was not retrieved.
highlights: Google and Range Media launch 100 Zeros
Rotating fund for onscreen depictions of tech
Also a way to test AI tools
Basis: Techmeme excerpt of the NYT
